reason: The preregistered ordinary native comparison shows no speed gain. All four paired process means regress at one thread, on large inputs and on UI; the 16-thread aggregate also regresses. No compelling distinct-input process-memory gain compensates for the broad migration.
changes: Only RValue Call/MethodCall/Select payloads boxed, plus exact forwarding/conversions and mechanical consumers. Select itself and all algorithms, pass order, budgets, metadata, numeric precision and scalar arity remain unchanged.
validation_scope: 68 focused tests and workspace/all-target compile passed. All 3978 CLI sources and timed API results match accepted hashes. Full workspace tests, native15 and actual Wasm gates were intentionally NOT run after the performance rejection; no claim of their completion for W12.
inference_limit: Smaller native storage models did not predict faster execution or comparable peak-memory reductions. Additional indirection/allocation is a plausible cost, not a measured isolated causal attribution. No extra timing run, outlier removal or output weakening was used to rescue this prototype.
overall_target: 3x-5x not achieved. These W11-relative results must not be multiplied with separate cohorts.

# W12 compact RValue pilot D

Baseline is committed6bbdcc1 (W11), not the original engine. Goal3x-5x remains unmet.
Only outer RValue::{Call,MethodCall,Select} gain owned boxes; Select's own variants
and scalar/multiple-result semantics remain unchanged. No compression of literal
bits/vector precision or metadata. Exact native models: RValue72->40B,
Statement128->112B,TableEntry144->80B. Actual compiled sizes still require checks.

Existing real-corpus snapshots support144332 new payload boxes at input and135381
postSSA. The additional rawCall part versus48B option A is6488 in each snapshot.
These are incidences, not cumulative allocations/clones; later AST passes create
calls and directCall->Select conversions may free/reallocate wrappers. Disjoint
physical-storage models save26.50%/24.35% of the modeled input/postSSA subset,
not that percentage of peak process memory or runtime. See layout-costs evidence.

Why D over A/B/C: D reaches40B while preserving Select's own API. B/C change inner
Select payload APIs for only a modest extra snapshot saving. D's rawCall migration
is broader than A, so a merely invisible CPU improvement is insufficient evidence
by itself for this larger change.

Invariants: exact visitor order/stopping/budgets; boxes are not new visited nodes;
Reduce continues to treat calls/methods/Select as opaque; preserve Call's hidden
callee_after_arguments/reconstruction_event fields; stable callee child Box<RValue>
pointers used by scoped SSA search remain intact; move payloads rather than
introduce clones; preserve explicit old clones and truthful origins. Preserve
From/TryFrom convenience and error text. Raw RValue constructors/EnumAsInner types
change to Box<T>; public decompile APIs are unchanged. Explicit UTF8 edits only.

Before timing: one frozen ordinary native release build; workspace/all-target
compile and meaningful conversion/visitor/arity/storage tests; all3978 accepted CLI
source hashes must match. No diagnostics/census features in ordinary build.

Timing: unchanged benchmark_multi.py, W11 versus D;4 balanced independent process
rounds, prewarm archived separately, unique1/16threads,large1,UI1. Samecompiler,
profile,allocator,flags,acceptedmanifest/CPUaffinity. All owned jobs idle. First
calls/rawoutliers retained; repeatedmeans andpairedprocessmeans reported separately
frommedians. Archive executable files must be uncompressed ordinary copies.

Decision: >=5% mean improvement on distinct input at1 or16threads, with consistent
paired direction and no material regression in the other groups, is the strong
success criterion. Smaller/mixed results require explicitcost/complexity review;
do not automatically promote because a size_of model is smaller. Fullworkspace,
native/runtime/metadata/cache and actualWasmquality gates follow only if ordinary
results justify keeping it. Output quality remains mandatory, never a speed mode.
No W12Worker speed claim without a separately matched Worker measurement.

Pre-build refinement: model E (D plus boxed Closure) still has RValue40B
and unchanged container sizes; rejected before implementation/timing. D unchanged.

data.representation: D: outer RValue Call/MethodCall/Select boxed; inner Select unchanged; Closure unchanged
notes: RValue Reduce and reduce_condition are unchanged and keep Call/MethodCall/Select in the other=>other arm; no new unbox/rebox for opaque reduction.
From<T> allocates the intentional payload Box and moves every field; TryFrom<RValue> delegates old enum_dispatch error construction and moves *Box, without clone.
Node-origin changes are exactly four Select box patterns; raw Call/MethodCall field reads dereference transparently. No new origin owner/snapshot/clone registration.
Trait forwarding body is byte-identical to the previous statement implementation, preserving early stop, duplicates, mutation order, and override selection.
Derived Box Clone/Debug/PartialEq delegate once to the old payload behavior. Clone adds the intended payload allocation but no extra Local or closure owner beyond the previous payload clone.
Public ast Rust raw constructors and generated accessors now expose Box payloads; public decompile API remains unchanged.
The heap location of a Call/MethodCall/Select payload changes; node origins remain owned fields, and no new pointer-derived identity or unsafe code was introduced.
No algorithmic or source-quality issue identified in this bounded core review; corpus/artifact gates remain necessary.

data.scope: Reuse complete W11 census from pre-boxing c50; apply observed slot capacities to W11 four-box baseline and A/B/C/D layout models. No new census/build/test/timing by this analysis; tiny layout probes were supplied by the AST agent.
no_double_counting: RValue node totals are frequency denominators, never multiplied wholesale and added to enclosing Statement storage.
Vec<RValue> capacity counts spare elements; table-entry capacity includes both value and Option-key storage even for absent keys and unused entries.

Existing Box<RValue> instances are derived once from each physical Call/MethodCall,Index(LValue or RValue),Unary,Binary,IfExpression payload. Their parent enum/container storage is separately counted.
Select subtypes are part of RValue::Select, not additional RValue nodes. A/D add one Select allocation; B/C add one inner payload allocation. Never add both.
Statement slots use the full enum capacity. If/While/Repeat/SetList inline RValue fields are already inside those slots. Existing four-loop boxes use their full changed payload size once.
AST Local metadata, Vec headers, pointer/Arc headers, allocator rounding, strings, stacks/temporaries, short-lived cloned trees and child Function bodies are outside this partial model.

Stage sums are separate corpus aggregates of per-function snapshots, not simultaneous peak heap or cumulative allocation traffic. Actual capacities after a rewrite are held constant as a counterfactual, not remeasured.
All sizes are native x86_64 compiler-specific. Source/API parity and performance require separate pilot validation; no speed claim follows.

migration.A: Changes two outer RValue payloads; Select constructors, payload API and owned Select helpers remain unchanged. Nested RValue::Select patterns must dereference the new Box; preserve From<Select>,TryInto<Select> compatibility explicitly.
migration.B: Changes outer MethodCall and inner Select Call/MethodCall payloads. Outer Select patterns remain, but Select From/TryInto/EnumAsInner and owned call conversions change; mixed raw Call|selected Call patterns need explicit handling.
migration.C: Also boxes raw RValue::Call. Both branches of raw/selected Call or-patterns then bind Box<Call>, but raw Call constructors/getters become another public AST API change.
migration.D: A plus raw RValue::Call boxing reaches 40-byte RValue while preserving Select payload APIs. Raw Call boundaries and or-patterns need explicit dereference, but inner Select constructors/From/TryInto/EnumAsInner stay unchanged.
migration.public_api: These are Rust ast-crate representation changes; public source/artifact decompiler signatures need not change. Select scalar-result versus raw multret calls, late-callee fields, origins, capture identity and trait callback order must stay exact.

data.decision: D has the strongest storage case among options that preserve Select payload APIs: it adds 6,488 raw-call boxes over A but shrinks every observed RValue heap slot another 8 bytes. B/C save only about 1.3MB over corresponding A/D while changing Select payload APIs. Snapshot raw-call frequency is small; later AST creation and cumulative clone/allocation frequency remain unmeasured. Treat D as a bounded quality/performance pilot, not a guaranteed speedup.

cpu_affinity.reason: Hybrid CPU and observed unrelated background load. Pin single-thread API samples to the same performance core; retain normal priority. Multi-thread samples use all logical processors. User processes are not modified.

data.contract: Rotated independent-process variant order; workload order reverses on alternate process rounds. First calls excluded from mean/median summaries, retained in raw rows. All accepted baseline output hashes enforced on every result. Unique removes byte-identical payload duplicates before API, so its speedup cannot be due to batch duplicate sharing. No input/filesystem cold-cache claim. Process peak working set includes loading, verification and retained results; not heap payload. Optional prewarm runs are archived separately and were declared before the cohort. Instrumented timing is diagnostic only and must not be used as performance evidence.

data.note: Ordinary native API only. All observations retained; first calls/prewarm excluded from repeat means. Peak working set is process memory, not live AST. Do not multiply with other cohorts.
